output.reason: The upgrade-guide section this item points to [ev-43cc6d389282] says the removed items are the CLI flags `-boltdb.shipper.shared-store` [ev-3d75e7ce1720] and `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store` [ev-15a875cd9a39] "and the corresponding YAML settings". It also says that anyone who configured either flag or its YAML setting must at least remove it [ev-7d2769e8c602][ev-af5a4b32c120]. Anyone who configured neither needs no change [ev-0483f04624d3]. The proposed condition only checks for the YAML key in a ConfigMap, so it misses environments that set the removed flags as container arguments. The corrected exposure matches the YAML line or either flag.

correction.statement: Loki 3.0.0 removes the shipper `shared_store` setting: the YAML `shared_store` key and the CLI flags `-boltdb.shipper.shared-store` and `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store`. An environment is exposed if its Loki config file sets `shared_store` or its workloads pass either flag.
